steps: Parked Spear+Dagger from StarterPack into ServerStorage
generate_mesh a falchion sword (tapered single-edged blade, crossguard, wrapped grip, round pommel) at 3.6 studs
save_mesh persisted the mesh (durable asset 137106165181737 + texture)
make_tool -> Falchion Tool (single MeshPart Handle), moved into StarterPack

recipe.text: Fresh falchion concept (distinct from prior daggers/spears/scimitars): a Cube-generated one-handed sword with a slender tapered blade converging to a point, straight crossguard, wrapped grip and round pommel. Mesh saved durable so the Handle survives Play. Tool lives in StarterPack; behavior runs idle->windup(0.1)->active(0.12)->cooldown(0.28)->idle, and the hitbox sweeps 7 studs for 28 damage once per swing on the active window with a 0.28s server cooldown.
